query:
SELECT
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM collection_reports
                    WHERE collection_id = $1 AND reporter_id = $2 AND resolved_at IS NULL
                ) as "open!",
                (
                    SELECT count(*) FROM collection_reports
                    WHERE reporter_id = $2 AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
                ) as "recent!"
